name: TacoBar Street
tagline: Traditional tacos with a splash of Asian, voted best food truck seven years running.
about: TacoBar Street is a Corpus Christi food truck that mixes traditional tacos with Asian influences.
Readers voted it best food truck in the Local's List poll seven years in a row.
address: 4711 S Alameda St, Corpus Christi, TX 78412
conflicts: Another article lists 150 W. Ave. A, Robstown.
